Reversal: I flipped the defaults at AnthropicProvider.swift:28,38 and OpenAIProvider.swift:38,49 to true, and both default_init_never_refreshes_expired_token tests went RED.

AnthropicProviderE2ETests.swift:318 and OpenAIProviderE2ETests.swift:228 leave out the manageOAuthRefresh argument on purpose, and a one-line comment says why. The Anthropic test reuses the extracted helpers. The OpenAI test uses the same `var oauthHits` capture already in that file (:114, :158), so it stays consistent. Assertions are atomic, and the second one checks that the token on disk did not change.
